title: [Lean] Lift local instruction-prefix facts through typed tapes
body:
## Completed reusable result

Explicit author-checked context: upstream main 0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. This generic theorem neither uses nor changes kappa.

One new module proves that lowering commutes with typed concatenation, operation constraints split across concatenation, and local instruction-prefix properties lift through arbitrary typed tapes. Domain membership is propagated along actual execution; empty phase code and arbitrary prefixes are included. No inverse premise or assumed whole-tape conclusion is needed.

Finite coverage: parameterized finite operation and instruction lists; no selected numerical census.
Conditional-interface coverage: callers supply phase code, interpreter empty/append laws, local domain closure and local prefix facts, initial domain membership and initial property.
Full-theorem coverage: no complete multiplication theorem, physical allocation, metadata storage cost, compound workspace or final runtime/precision bound is claimed.

## Reuse, evidence and reproduction

Reuse unchanged AdmissibleTypedTape from PR1835 at e41a160c77e559b8023a59c14af08fceeaf33c9a in a fresh temporary build directory. Its source is not duplicated. The new source SHA256 is 9bb5d28159cc6c4871b67e8e057ed8a9533d7d7ce5fe50866cd787712f0a9829. It compiled unchanged; all three axiom probes and the complete theorem type were independently accepted without warnings. Only standard Lean axioms occur; no Mathlib dependency is needed.

README gives version/source checks and serial reproduction commands. The public source-bound acceptance summary is included; detailed original review records are preserved with the authors. A separately accepted scratch-save application is outside this source closure. Prior checks are evidence for these exact source bytes, not a relocated replay. No extra local CI preflight was run; repository CI is inspected after submission.

## Attribution and comparison

James Chang with OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0; Lean and unchanged dependency attribution retained. The scoped comparison preserves PR1530 dispatcher motivation, PR590/597 interpreter interfaces, PR896 commutator restoration and PR612 selected Boolean semantics. This adds arbitrary typed phase-code prefix lifting, without claiming inverse or spectator reasoning itself is novel. Physical storage and implementation refinements remain separate follow-on work.
